scripts.setup: node scripts/init-env.js && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build:docker
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && npm --prefix frontend start
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:notifications: docker compose exec -T backend pytest tests/test_notifications.py && npm --prefix frontend test -- src/pages/Notifications.test.js --watchAll=false
scripts.test:notifications:backend: docker compose exec -T backend pytest tests/test_notifications.py
scripts.test:seeding: docker compose exec -T backend pytest tests/test_seeding.py
scripts.seed: docker compose exec -T backend python -m seeds.cli --seed
scripts.seed:reset: docker compose exec -T backend python -m seeds.cli --reset
scripts.seed:clean: docker compose exec -T backend python -m seeds.cli --clean
scripts.seed:status: docker compose exec -T backend python -m seeds.cli --status
